ui.setup.screen_secrets: A password for the panel, a passphrase for the vault
ui.setup.welcome_line: Pour a coffee and sit back; this takes about a minute.
ui.setup.welcome_note: Nothing is written until the last screen confirms it, and Back steps through the questions again.
ui.setup.language_lead: The language the panel is drawn in. The terminal stays English.
ui.setup.secrets_lead: The password signs you into the panel. The passphrase seals every credential this box will hold, and restoring a backup asks for it again; keep it somewhere safe.
ui.setup.ports_server_lead: No port is given a job. Every one of them keeps the address it has and answers to begin with; the panel's Network page narrows that afterwards.
ui.setup.port_one_arm: The one port, out and in
ui.setup.proxy_lead_server: Send this box's own traffic out through an exit node you own. Skipping is a real answer: a hub is a hub without a proxy, and the Proxy page turns one on later without any of this being redone.
ui.setup.proxy_lead_router: Send your devices' traffic out through an exit node you own. Skipping is a real answer: a hub is a hub without a proxy, and the Proxy page turns one on later without any of this being redone.
ui.setup.socks_direct_enable: Also publish a SOCKS port that bypasses the proxy
ui.setup.proxy_local: Send this box's own traffic through it
ui.setup.review_lead_owned: This is what the box becomes. Confirming applies it: the ports change, the firewall loads and the services start.
ui.setup.review_lead_kept: This is what the box becomes. Confirming applies it: the firewall loads and the services start. Every address on this machine is left as it is.
ui.setup.interruption: The initialization process will finish on its own, network might be interrupted, please refresh and reconnect when interruption happens.
ui.setup.panel_will_be_at: The panel will be at {url}, and the run is written to {path}.
ui.setup.handover: The panel is starting. This page goes there in {seconds} s.
ui.setup.failed_lead: Nothing else will happen here. The terminal that started this has the command output that explains it.
ui.setup.lost: This page is no longer on the same wire as the box; its ports are being taken over, which is one of the steps. The work carries on there. It will be at {url}.
ui.setup.step_failed: a step failed; the terminal has the output
ui.setup.waiting_title: This box is waiting to be set up
ui.setup.waiting_lead: Open the link the terminal printed. It carries a one-time token, and the wizard does not answer without it.
ui.setup.waiting_hint: The token is good for this run only. If the terminal has scrolled past it, stop the run with Ctrl-C and start it again.
ui.setup.mode_summary_server: Routes nothing; answers where it is reached.
ui.setup.mode_summary_side_gateway: Forwards for hosts that name it as their gateway.
ui.setup.mode_summary_router: Routes between uplinks and the networks it serves.
ui.setup.mode_summary_one_arm_router: Routes on one wire: untagged out, tagged VLAN in.
ui.setup.mode_caution_one_arm_router: The switch it plugs into has to pass VLAN tags. On a plain switch this looks configured and carries nothing.
ui.setup.router_note: Only the primary way out and the primary served network are set here. The panel's Network page adds more.
ui.setup.step_required_packages: Checking the packages the hub needs
